audit.notes: Disney 2026 frame from the vivo X500 Pro Max PAG (photo layers replaced with transparency; 40/40 layer checks). Canvas is the PAG composition 1440x1234 = photo 1440x1080 + 154 bar (white material). 2026-11-19: the shipped composite is split into the bar (style background + this bottom band) and the character art, cropped to its ink box 456x249 at (953,985) of the composite (alpha>8 and non-white; the bar itself is opaque white) as vivo/disney/mickey-art.png. The art is a right/bottom-anchored image node in the bottom band, so every photo aspect keeps it flush with the canvas corner; the old full-canvas overlay was anchored to the photo rect and pushed the art out of frame on 3:2 / 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1.
unsupported: PAG composition is authored 4:3 (1440x1234); IR has no per-ratio composition, so the art keeps its 4:3 node size at referenceWidth 1440 and only its distance from the photo bottom follows the 154 bar

art node is 456x249 and deliberately rises 95 units above the 154 bar into the photo (band fit:"none", node margins right 31 / bottom 0); the photo/art overlap of the 4:3 composition is preserved, not removed, so a non-4:3 photo shows the art over a different slice of the photo — never at a different canvas position

vendor material #2 (pag/.../black, blue card) is a different composition (photo window 1440x864 + blue band 864-1080 + white bar 1080-1234) and is not shipped as a theme — GAP; firmware pref_camera_watermark_material therefore only carries the white value here
roll/tilt vector layer inside the PAG photo area is part of the photo replacement, not the decoration
